Name: Air Shield
Description: Blessing of the air, the power of the sky will bring no harm to them.

Name: Berserk
Description: Desolation, destruction, elimination and eradication! Stop at nothing until your enemy is no more. Highly increase offence and speed, but reduce defence.

Name: Betrayal
Description: Betrayal against their former master, the new one had better be more generous.

Name: Blacked Out
Description: Blacked out from consciousness and combat. A dangerous respite.

Name: Bleeding
Description: A bleeding wound is often not much emergency issue in the face of life and death in battle. Such a wound still takes its toll in long term, though.

Name: Bless
Description: Blessed with divine power, there is no doubt that their victory is sanctioned by heaven.

Name: Blind
Description: Blindness is pretty much the equivalent of certain death in battle. Unable to fight effectively, such disability must be treated as soon as possible.

Name: Bloom
Description: Blooming with arcane essence, physical and magical resources seem to wondrously materialise.

Name: Brave
Description: Bravery is one of the foremost traits to have for a good warrior. Cowards die many times before their death.

Name: Burn
Description: Dead by burning is not a good way to go. Try to drench yourselves as soon as possible.

Name: Charge
Description: Charging with speed into enemies. Only Gods may decide the fate of the encounter.

Name: Clarity
Description: Clarity of the mind. No manipulation will thwart a warrior from their fight.

Name: Cold
Description: Cold and shivering. Become slightly less effective in combat and vulnerable to water damage. Find some place warm or light up the fire.

Name: Collapse
Description: Collapse into a state unbefitting of combat, perhaps a prompt rescue is in order.

Name: Confident
Description: Be confident and march onward. Strike with conviction and spare no mercy.

Name: Confuse
Description: "What is going on? What is happening?" Confusion in battle may last a short time, but such a condition may as well cause defeat.

Name: Cripple
Description: Cripple in body, but can the heart hold out? Only time will tell.

Name: Cure
Description: Cure from negative physical manifestations. A healthy warrior for a hearty combat.

Name: Curse
Description: Unholy curse power, the like of which only the foulest of creatures can conjure. Misfortune becomes the definition of the victim.

Name: Daze
Description: Difficult to focus on the fight, regain concentration fast or perish.

Name: Deadly Poison
Description: A deadly poison that cannot be cured. Very few can survive this painful experience, and even fewer can live a long life after.

Name: Defence Boost
Description: Improved in defence. Allowing to block incoming hits with better ease.

Name: Disarmed
Description: Losing a weapon is a shame that any warrior worth their salt should reconsider their life. But now is a good time to run.

Name: Disorient
Description: Blow to the mind, even a simple action becomes difficult to perform.

Name: Disrupt
Description: Disruption must be quelled before chaos breaks out.

Name: Distract
Description: Distracted from battle. Not even the best shield will help when its wielder does not focus on the enemies.

Name: Drench
Description: Wet from head to toes, almost as if swimming in the water. Avoid cold temperature or air element damage at all costs.

Name: Drunk
Description: Getting drunk in battle may not be the smartest thing to do, but It sure helps raise the morale and fierceness of the unit.

Name: Earth Shield
Description: Blessing of the earth, to be its guardian forevermore.

Name: Electrocution
Description: Electric shock causes not just mere pain, but it also leaves the victim's body in extreme constriction.

Name: Enraged
Description: Enraged enough to attack with intensity, but not enough to forget to defend.

Name: Escalation Phase 1
Description: Escalation begins, weakness prevails, yet strength awaits.

Name: Escalation Phase 2
Description: Escalation progresses, weakness retreats, strength approaches.

Name: Escalation Phase 3
Description: Escalation climax, weakness ends, strength permeates.

Name: Excited
Description: There is no greater thrill than to be in the face of death.

Name: False Advance
Description: The advance order dictates that one must advance into the enemy's blade.

Name: False Idle
Description: Stay still and await another order.

Name: False Retreat
Description: You are permitted to return home. Go now, while we secure your retreat.

Name: Fear
Description: There should be no fear in the machine of war. Fear makes even obedient soldiers refuse to follow the command after all.

Name: Flame Shield
Description: With fire as an ally and shield, no other flame can truly harm them.

Name: Freezing
Description: Frozen in place and time. Nothing to be done but wait.

Name: Full Power
Description: Into full power and full offensive. The best moment to attack is now.

Name: Half Resource Cost
Description: Be more efficient, and you will find that resources exist more than you think.

Name: Haste
Description: Overflowed with speed. So reached half a victory.

Name: Health Potion
Description: Health potions are rudimentary articles for all adventurers and heroes. Difficult to mass-produce, they serve as healing items for those with the means to acquire them.

Name: Hope
Description: Optimism to survive and see the better days is good. A soldier always fights harder when there is hope.

Name: Hot
Description: Hot, is it not? Be careful of heatstroke.

Name: Invisible
Description: Invisible to all eyes. Who can defend what they cannot perceive?

Name: Jousting Charge
Description: The art of jousting is more than entertainment. Know the rhythm, momentum, and placement. A charge is as effective as its charger can be.

Name: Large Health Potion
Description: Large health potions are expensive but effective. They can heal even grievous wounds that take weeks to heal in an instant.

Name: Loyalty
Description: Affirm loyalty. Any betrayal can be reversed with the right incentive.

Name: Magic Barrier
Description: Magic can be used both offensively and defensively. Controlling magic power to create a thin but durable barrier is one useful way to protect oneself with magic.

Name: Marked For Death
Description: Being a target of assassination means many things, one being that it is definitely going to be difficult to live leisurely.

Name: Offence Boost
Description: With improved offence, one can eliminate even more enemies.

Name: Oiled
Description: Oiled up and ready to be cooked. This unit will catch fire much faster.

Name: Overload
Description: Overload with power, become better at attacking at the cost of defence.

Name: Panic
Description: "Forward! I said forward you fool! Listen to my command!"

Name: Paralysis
Description: Unable to move, a sitting duck waiting for death deliver.

Name: Petrify
Description: Inside turns into stone temporarily. Extremely vulnerable in the meantime.

Name: Pin Down
Description: Pinned down in place and unable to move quickly. A primed target for a hail of arrows.

Name: Plague
Description: Anyone with a plague is dangerous to everyone around him, especially when so many people are staying so close in tight formation.

Name: Poison
Description: A dangerous substance that causes damage over time. Endure and hope for the best or seek aid.

Name: Provoke
Description: No longer calm and collected, such an aggravated mind is easy to trick.

Name: Pure Focus
Description: Focus only on victory. Optimise all available resources to achieve it.

Name: Regeneration
Description: Wounds can be healed naturally, but such a slow process can be insufficient. The faster the recovery, the more fights can be done.

Name: Resource Generation
Description: Regenerating resources is crucial. Combat effectiveness depends on the resources available to be used after all.

Name: Resource Potion
Description: Resource potions improve the focus of the user, allowing them to fight more efficiently.

Name: Second Wind
Description: Regaining lost health to enjoy the fight a little longer.

Name: Slow
Description: Slowing to a crawl. Best be steady, or you may lose both race and war.

Name: Smoke
Description: Block and blinded by smoke. Great for hiding from attacks, but also not the best circumstance for attacking.

Name: Speed Boost
Description: The victory starts with a timely step. So move fast and seize it.

Name: Stone Skin
Description: Skin turned to stone, allowing for better defence but creating weakness to impact-type damage.

Name: Strengthen
Description: Extra strength always helps with attacking.

Name: Stun
Description: Vision blur, hearing deafen, regain oneself or be perished.

Name: Supreme Defence
Description: There is no offence without defence. The best defence creates the greatest opportunity.

Name: Terror
Description: How can one fight under terror? It would be better to run far away from this accursed battlefield.

Name: Time Stop
Description: Control the time, control the destiny.

Name: Wet
Description: Being wet can be either good or bad. Fire and burning become much less effective, but the damage and effect of air and water become a dangerous threat.
